scope: All 58-vertex degree-eight diameter-two graphs admitting a 29+29 partition with induced internal degree two and cross degree six. Both internal graphs and all cross edges are free. Right relabeling normalizes H0*C+C*H1+C to J+I without fixing any cycle type. No extra symmetry, triangle, diagonal-C, or Hamilton-exclusion clauses. This partition family is not all 58-vertex graphs.
